title: 第24章 他说的话就是证据！
novel_title: 觉醒阴阳神功：分手后我爽麻了
content_zh:
陈阳迎着众人的目光，语气坚定说：“冰姐，这个赵凯人品不行，不配拿下这个项目，更不配待在苏氏集团。”

    赵凯瞬间炸了，双眼瞪得通红，指着陈阳怒声吼道：“闭嘴！这里有你说话的份吗？一个小小的厨师，也敢在这里胡言乱语！”

    “赵凯，你闭嘴！”苏冰突然叫。

    赵凯瞬间傻眼了，愣在原地，不敢相信自己的耳朵。

    苏冰总裁竟然帮着陈阳这土狗，让他闭嘴？

    黄金龙也一脸意外，看向苏冰的眼神里满是不解。

    苏冰冷冷瞥了赵凯一眼，转头看向陈阳，语气缓和了几分：“你接着说，他怎么人品不行了。”

    陈阳抬眸看向赵凯，眼神里满是不屑，缓缓说：“这个赵凯，在外面经常去夜店找女人鬼混。

    而且他嗜酒如命，每次喝醉之后，都会动手打人闹事，品行极其恶劣。”

    赵凯气得浑身发抖，指着陈阳，怒极反笑：“小子，你胡说八道！你有证据吗？没有证据就别在这里血口喷人！”

    陈阳嗤笑一声，语气随意：“证据我懒得找，不过冰姐，你听我一句劝，把他开除了，免得他以后祸害你公司，影响你公司的声誉。”

    苏冰皱起眉头，神色有些犹豫。

    她不知道陈阳为什么要执意开除赵凯，但赵凯有把握拿下刘家的项目，若是贸然开除他，恐怕会影响公司大计。

    她下意识看向杨婷，眼神里带着一丝询问。

    杨婷轻轻摇了摇头，眼神里满是疑惑，显然也不知道陈阳的用意，也从未听说过赵凯有这些劣迹。

    赵凯见状，连忙上前一步，对着苏冰急切说：“总裁，您别听他胡说！他就是一个小酒店的厨师，就是个骗子，他是故意嫉妒我，想毁了我的前途！”

    说着，他转头看向黄金龙，眼神里带着求助。

    黄金龙连忙上前，语气诚恳说：“总裁，还是以公司业务为重啊！刘家这个项目事关重大，可不能受外人影响，耽误了公司大计啊！”

    苏冰的神色更加犹豫了，一边是陈阳的坚持，一边是10亿的大项目，她一时难以抉择。

    毕竟，若是赵凯真的能谈下项目，对苏氏集团的益处太大了。
content_en:
Chen Yang met everyone's gaze and said firmly: "Sister Bing, this Zhao Kai has no good character and is not worthy of winning this project, let alone staying in the Su Group."

Zhao Kai exploded instantly, his eyes turned red, he pointed at Chen Yang and shouted angrily: "Shut up! Do you have the right to speak here? A little chef dares to talk nonsense here!"

"Zhao Kai, shut up!" Su Bing suddenly shouted.

Zhao Kai was dumbfounded for a moment and froze on the spot, unable to believe his ears.

President Su Bing actually helped Chen Yang, a bitch, to shut up?

The golden dragon also looked surprised, looking at Su Bing with confusion in his eyes.

Su Bingbing glanced at Zhao Kai coldly, turned to look at Chen Yang, and softened his tone a little: "Tell me, why is his character so bad?"

Chen Yang raised his eyes to look at Zhao Kai, his eyes full of disdain, and said slowly: "This Zhao Kai often goes to nightclubs to hang out with women outside.

Moreover, he was addicted to alcohol. Every time he got drunk, he would hit people and cause trouble. His conduct was extremely bad."

Zhao Kai was so angry that he was shaking all over. He pointed at Chen Yang and laughed angrily: "Boy, you are talking nonsense! Do you have evidence? If you don't have evidence, don't rant here!"

Chen Yang sneered and said in a casual tone: "I'm too lazy to look for evidence, but Sister Bing, please listen to my advice and fire him, so that he will not harm your company and affect your company's reputation in the future."

Su Bing frowned, looking a little hesitant.

She didn't know why Chen Yang insisted on firing Zhao Kai, but Zhao Kai was confident of winning the Liu family's project. If he were to be fired rashly, it might affect the company's overall plans.

She looked at Yang Ting subconsciously, with a hint of questioning in her eyes.

Yang Ting shook her head slightly, her eyes full of doubts. She obviously didn't know Chen Yang's intentions, and she had never heard of Zhao Kai's misdeeds.

Seeing this, Zhao Kai quickly stepped forward and said urgently to Su Bing: "President, don't listen to his nonsense! He is just a chef in a small hotel and a liar. He is deliberately jealous of me and wants to ruin my future!"

As he said that, he turned to look at the golden dragon, with a look of help in his eyes.

Huang Jinlong hurriedly stepped forward and said in a sincere tone: "President, the company's business is the most important thing! This project of the Liu family is of great importance, and we cannot be influenced by outsiders and delay the company's plans!"

Su Bing's expression became even more hesitant. Between Chen Yang's insistence and the 1 billion big project, she couldn't decide.

After all, if Zhao Kai can really negotiate a project, it will be of great benefit to the Su Group.
title_en: Chapter 24 What he said is evidence!
